'''Emperor''' was a pet [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]] that was kept by [[Kedar Blackgate]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who commanded the [[Dorthus Tal Prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CCW" />
